description: Sound effects and music. Owned by lane D.

assets.spec: Bright short coin pickup chime, < 150 ms, mono OGG/MP3 44.1 kHz, peak -3 dBFS. Engine pitches it up across consecutive pickups.
Soft landing thud on gravel, < 150 ms, mono.
Light air swish for lane change, < 150 ms, mono.
Impact crash (body into metal), < 600 ms, mono.
Power-up pickup: bright rising arpeggio, < 400 ms, mono.
Side bump / stumble: dull thud with a scrape, < 300 ms, mono.
Hoverboard power-on hum sweep, < 500 ms, mono.
Mission complete: two-note chime, < 500 ms, mono.
Near miss: a close air swish past the ear with a tiny bright tick, < 200 ms, mono.
Perfect dodge: small bright bell, < 400 ms, mono. Engine raises the pitch along a perfect streak.
Combo milestone (every 5): short three-note brass rise, < 500 ms, mono. Engine raises the pitch per milestone.
Hit absorbed by a shield / the Aegis: metallic clang, < 400 ms, mono.
Road event starts (market, ambush, storm…): two-note hunting horn call, < 1 s, mono.
Results with a new record or level: short royal fanfare, < 1 s, mono.
In-run music loop: upbeat, ~128 BPM, seamless loop of 15-60 s, stereo or mono OGG/MP3 44.1 kHz, peak -6 dBFS.
